guard.instructions: Find the single riskiest operation in this numbered code slice (force unwrap, array subscript, file write or delete, cross-thread state access, unowned capture, arithmetic on a possibly zero or empty value). Is that operation protected in the lines shown?

criteria.unguarded: nothing in the lines shown checks the condition before the risky operation runs; a nil, empty, missing, failed or concurrent case reaches it
criteria.guarded: a guard, if-let, bounds or isEmpty check, do-catch, lock, main-actor hop or default value covers the risky operation
criteria.benign: there is no risky operation in these lines

ships.instructions: Does this code run for end users of the shipped app, or is it developer-only?

criteria.user_facing: app feature code that runs on a teacher's iPad during normal use
criteria.dev_only: probe, verification harness, test helper, audit or build script, debug-only path
